The busier positional facts (first within 200 m at 13:01:00, cumulative 4 min 30 s inside the radius, 3 min 15 s stationary) measure time before the arrival confirmation, which NS-1 expressly excludes from (iii); only the post-tap interval counts [F2][F3][F4][NS-1]. The driver's chat "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" and his post-trip statement that he waited over 3 minutes are statements that the shorter measured post-tap interval contradicts, and system records override statements [F10][F12][F6][NS-1]. The trace confirms the GPS samples run from confirmation to cancellation without a hole, so (iii) is measurable and settled, not undetermined [F2][F6][NS-1].

With NS-1 (i)–(iii) not all satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full [F4][F7][NS-2]. Amount = the cancellation fee on record, $6.61 [F7][F4][NS-2].

flag_account is not triggered under NS-2's extra clause: the driver did press "I'm Here" while actually within the pickup radius (39 m), so there was no false arrival confirmation [F6][F1][NS-2]. RD-6 is not applicable — this is a no-show fee dispute, not an established route-deviation refund > 0 [F4][F16][F17][RD-6]. The traffic and weather facts are irrelevant to the no-show elements: the driver was already at the pickup, and the speed band shows only moderate traffic that does not excuse the shortfall in wait time [F13][F14][F15][NS-1].

You were charged $6.61 after the driver marked you as a no-show, but the trip record shows the driver cancelled, and the driver's location history shows he did not keep waiting at the pickup for the required time after confirming he had arrived. Because of that, the fee was not validly charged. You'll get $6.61 back as a Ryde voucher — no action needed on your side. Your account has no flag, and nothing else changes for you.

You did confirm arrival at the pickup, but the location history shows you stayed within the pickup area for less than the required waiting time after that confirmation before you cancelled. That means the no-show fee did not apply. This will be noted on the trip record for account-review tracking; no flag is being placed on your account this time.
